name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.10 Antenna Flow
author: James
description: Series-management release. v0.22.10 restores administrator Series editing with native Jellyfin EDIT SERIES and IDENTIFY SERIES actions both on Series detail pages and in the Series Velvet Lens. The controls use Jellyfin's own itemAction edit/identify pathways and exact Series IDs rather than a custom metadata editor. v0.22.9 API-backed Collections grid and curated remote artwork picker, source-aware TMDb collection completeness through the optional Velvet Antenna Bridge, direct Add/Remove collection membership, v0.22.8 navigation reliability, permanent player EXIT, first-paint Home, Tonight, right-click administration and CC+ subtitle search remain included.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.11 CC+ Persistence Hotfix
author: James
description: Small compatibility hotfix for Antenna Flow. Keeps the Velvet Antenna CC+ subtitle-search launcher available during playback even when Jellyfin hides its native CC selector because no local subtitle tracks exist. Leaves Jellyfin's native subtitle availability and selection logic untouched.
